W1.evidence: `Polymer.Element` became `PolymerElement`, as `Element` would shadow over the native `Element` class.

W3.evidence: `importHref()` functionality is removed, please use the ES Module equivalent: `import('path/to/module.js')`

W8.evidence: a lot of API names have shortened now

H1-a.evidence: You'll need to convert your HTML Imports files to modules either manually, or using our [modulizer](https://github.com/Polymer/polymer-modulizer) tool.

H2.evidence:
Before: 
    ```html
    <link rel="import" href="polymer/lib/utils/case-map.html">
    <script>Polymer.CaseMap</script>
    ```
    After:
    ```js
    import {CaseMap} from "@polymer/polymer/lib/utils/case-map.js";
    ```

Y1.evidence: `Polymer.Element` became `PolymerElement`, as `Element` would shadow over the native `Element` class.

W7-a.evidence: use released versions of shadycss and webcomponentsjs; Bump dependencies; Bump to cli 1.7.0

W7-b.evidence: we're using ES Modules now!; Polymer CLI tooling and Webpack will automatically fix this up for browsers that don't support ES Modules.
